newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-NAC DEFENDER VIDMAR TO JOIN RANGERS NEXT SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NAC DEFENDER VIDMAR TO JOIN RANGERS NEXT SEASON.

text.p: Australian international defender Tony Vidmar will join Glasgow Rangers next season, the Dutch newspaper De Telegraaf reported.

De Telegraaf reported that Vidmar, 26, who plays for Dutch first division side NAC Breda, had signed a four-year contract with the Scottish champions. He is on a free transfer at the end of this season.
"I knew Rangers were interested in me, so were Dutch and German teams, but Rangers were at the top of my list," Vidmar said.
